value-1.chars: §4 L155 Roving zones (workspace): header toolbars (RG-08), the tab strip (RG-02), the tray (RG-04), the rail tree (RG-07), the chart's plot stop (one stop, the chart root: D03E06:103, :245)

value-2.chars: R-2 One stop per composite (§1.4 L117): a grid, tree, listbox, toolbar or tablist is one Tab stop with a roving tabindex

value-3.chars: §4 L156 Entry and exit keys (workspace): entry: Ctrl+\ / F6, Tab, a skip link; exit: Ctrl+\ / Shift+F6, Tab past the region

value-4.chars: Panel header bar and frame: the DOM panel is the focused panel (frame + bar in color.focus.ring, inside the box; §7.4 L249); its first header tool carries CMP-039

value-5.chars: The arrow glyphs in the tags name the keys inside each zone (APG; §4)

value-6.chars: Keyboard: Tab enters a zone on its one stop; ←/→ (↑/↓ in the tree) move inside; Tab leaves
